tool.name: datav-list-datasets
tool.description:
List all active datasets available for ChatBI query.
Returns a JSON array of dataset descriptors. Each descriptor contains: - sid: dataset ID (use as datasetSid in other datav-* tools) - dsName: dataset name - description: dataset description (may be empty) - dsType: dataset type (only "sql" type supports query)
Only datasets with status=active (status=1) are returned. Use this tool first to discover what data is available, then call datav-describe-dataset to understand fields/params, then datav-query-dataset to execute a query.
